carried_set_rule: One estimator is judged: the frozen -g1 fused tracker named in carried_models (decision 31's fused tracker on decision 32's guarded reference), with T2 bound by model_digests and the fused file tied to T2's prediction file by tma-g5's prediction chain. G5 exactly as Annex C §C.5 (five gated checks, 97.5% intervals, scenario-clustered bootstrap); pass if every gated check passes, fail if any fails, otherwise inconclusive, with one re-score on seed 219 (1,100,000; 110,000-scenario test split, phase-7 ranges).
change: Phase 7 (SRD Annex C §C.14, owner decisions 2026-11-08): judge the frozen fused tracker against the frozen IMM at G5 unchanged on data with realistic bearing error (generator 0.6.0, configs/phase7-ranges.json: Gauss-Markov 1.0 deg / 30 s plus a drifting bias 0.5 deg / 20 min). Nothing is trained, re-tuned or refitted; T2 keeps seed 211's normalisation.
rationale: On seed 217's validation split with realistic error (tma-g5 diagnostic, experiments/20261108-p7-val): fused/IMM overall range 0.777 [0.756, 0.798], course 0.922 [0.896, 0.942]; settled range 0.778, course 0.876, speed 0.889; every point within its limit (the carry rule), every interval too. Every tracker degrades (median range 1.7-1.8 x clean); the fused tracker least on range (interaction 0.920 [0.888, 0.954]). Forecast before scoring: P(G5 pass on seed 218) about 95%; the weakest check is overall course (upper bound 0.942 on validation).
